name: PDP Copy - Single Product Rewrite
description: Rewrites a single Shopify product description using OpenAI or Claude, generates SEO meta title/description, and auto-publishes

parameters.prompt:
You are a professional e-commerce copywriter specializing in product descriptions. 

Brand Voice: {{ $json.brandVoice }}
Product Category: {{ $json.category }}
Current Description: {{ $json.currentDescription }}
Keywords to include: {{ $json.keywords }}
Desired Length: {{ $json.length }} (Short: 100-150 words, Medium: 200-300 words, Long: 400-500 words)

Your task:
1. Rewrite the product description to be compelling, conversion-focused, and in the specified brand voice
2. Include primary benefits upfront
3. Highlight key features with benefits
4. Include a subtle call-to-action at the end
5. Optimize for the provided keywords without keyword stuffing
6. Make it scannable with short sentences and paragraphs

Respond ONLY with the rewritten description, no additional text.

notes:
This workflow processes a single product rewrite request. Setup instructions:
1. Create Shopify private app with scopes: write_products, read_products, write_metafields
2. Set environment variables: SHOPIFY_DOMAIN, WEBHOOK_ID, OPENAI_API_KEY, CLAUDE_API_KEY
3. Configure credentials in n8n for Shopify and OpenAI/Claude
4. Send POST request with JSON: { productId, aiProvider, brandVoice, keywords, length }
5. Workflow will rewrite and auto-publish to Shopify
